ABSTRACT

This study typologizes the digital transformation (DX) maturity levels of tenant small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) participating in the Smart Green Industrial Complex Promotion Project and derives type-specific characteristics and policy implications. Based on prior research, we develop a survey instrument comprising six dimensions-organization and strategy, data, technology, workforce and  culture, process, and collaboration-and conduct k-means cluster analysis after assessing measurement reliability and validity. The results classify firms into four maturity types: initiation, data-building, strategy-and-data building, and leading. Performance also differs across maturity levels, and data capability emerges as a key factor explaining both cluster membership and performance differences.
By quantitatively typologizing SME DX maturity at the industrial-complex level, this study provides empirical evidence to support a shift in the program from uniform support to maturity-based, tailored interventions.

sections.title: ABSTRACT
sections.content:
This study typologizes the digital transformation (DX) maturity levels of tenant small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) participating in the Smart Green Industrial Complex Promotion Project and derives type-specific characteristics and policy implications. Based on prior research, we develop a survey instrument comprising six dimensions-organization and strategy, data, technology, workforce and  culture, process, and collaboration-and conduct k-means cluster analysis after assessing measurement reliability and validity. The results classify firms into four maturity types: initiation, data-building, strategy-and-data building, and leading. Performance also differs across maturity levels, and data capability emerges as a key factor explaining both cluster membership and performance differences.
By quantitatively typologizing SME DX maturity at the industrial-complex level, this study provides empirical evidence to support a shift in the program from uniform support to maturity-based, tailored interventions.
